# Accepted FFmpeg builds, by exact asset name.
#
# Format:  <release asset name>  <sha256>  <platform>
#
# `scripts/fetch_ffmpeg.sh` refuses to install anything whose name is missing
# here, and refuses anything whose bytes do not match the hash. `--accept-unpinned`
# records a hash after printing it, so a pin is always a decision somebody made.
#
# Empty on purpose: no build has been fetched and reviewed on this branch yet.
